title: What is the purpose of the Revert lessons?
body: The Revert lessons guide new Muslims through the pillars, beliefs, and practices so you build solid foundational habits with clarity.

title: How often should I revisit a lesson?
body: We recommend reviewing a chapter weekly and journaling one key takeaway so that repetition strengthens your spiritual muscle.

title: Can I share these notes with a mentor?
body: Yes, export your reflections and invite someone you trust to review them—accountability brings accountability.
